title: Pharmacy
description: Dispensing paid prescriptions, stock, batches, and counts.

validation.cost: Enter an amount with up to 4 decimals
validation.factor: A whole number of 2 or more

queue.title: Dispensing
queue.description: Paid or authorized prescriptions waiting for the pharmacy.
queue.scanPlaceholder: Visit, file or invoice number, phone or name
queue.scanHint: Scan the receipt or file barcode: one match opens the prescription.
queue.emptyHint: Only paid or perform-first authorized lines appear here.
queue.noMatchHint: Unpaid prescriptions are not dispensed; send the patient to the cashier.
queue.noAccess: Use the other pharmacy screens for stock, documents and reports.

dispense.noBatches: No usable batch in this store.
dispense.partialTitle: {{rest}} units will not be given now

remainder.deferHint: Dispense it later, when stock arrives.
remainder.refundHint: A credit note and a refund request are opened; a cashier supervisor approves.

dispense.approverDescription: Refunding the rest needs a cashier supervisor or accountant.
dispense.qtyInvalid: Enter a whole quantity of 1 or more.
dispense.qtyTooMuch: At most {{max}} units remain on this line.
dispense.pickInvalid: Enter whole numbers for the chosen batches.
dispense.pickMismatch: The batches add up to {{chosen}}, the quantity is {{needed}}.
dispense.reasonRequired: Choose why another batch is used.
dispense.nothingChosen: Choose at least one line to dispense.
dispense.nothingLeft: Every line of this visit is given, cancelled or not paid.
dispense.doneBody: Stock was taken from these batches.

items.title: Items
items.description: Drugs and supplies with their units, barcodes and stock levels.
items.newDescription: Give a drug or consumable service its stock item. Stock is counted in the base unit.

fields.noServices: Every drug and consumable service already has an item.
fields.baseUnitCodeHint: The smallest unit, e.g. tablet or ml. It cannot change later.

pickers.itemPlaceholder: Search by name, code or barcode
pickers.batchPlaceholder: Search by item, batch number or barcode

receipts.title: Goods receipts
receipts.description: Goods received from suppliers with their batches, expiry and cost.
receipts.newDescription: Nothing enters stock until the receipt is posted. Expired goods are refused.
receipts.postDescription: Its batches enter the store's stock. A posted receipt never changes.
receipts.cancelDescription: The draft is kept as cancelled; nothing enters stock.
receipts.supplierRequired: A supplier needs a code and a name.

fields.unitCostHint: Per the unit chosen, in SDG

adjustments.title: Stock adjustments
adjustments.description: Corrections for damage, expiry or loss, approved by a supervisor.
adjustments.newDescription: Stock changes only when a supervisor approves, and never goes below zero.

counts.title: Stock counts
counts.description: Count the shelf against the book and post the differences.
counts.newDescription: Every batch with stock in the store is listed. One count per store at a time.

count.title: Stock count {{number, bidi}}
count.postDescription: Each variance becomes a count correction. A posted count never changes.
count.postHint: A manager posts the count once every batch is counted.
count.cancelDescription: Nothing moves; the count is kept as cancelled.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.description: Move stock between the main store, the pharmacy and departments.
transfers.newDescription: Stock leaves the source store when sent and arrives when received.
transfers.sendDescription: The stock leaves the source store now and is in transit until received.
transfers.shortage: Less arrived than was sent: say why. A supervisor approves.
transfers.approverDescription: A shortage needs a holder of the adjustment approval.
transfers.cancelDescription: The draft is kept as cancelled.
transfers.cancelSentDescription: The stock returns to the source store. Say why.

expiry.title: Expiry report
expiry.description: Batches with stock that expire soon. Expired batches are never dispensed.

lowStock.title: Low stock
lowStock.description: Items at or below their minimum, with the quantity to reorder.

sale.title: Walk-in sale
sale.description: Sell to a customer without a visit. The cashier collects; the pharmacy dispenses once paid.
sale.moreThanStock: More than is in stock: it can be dispensed only when stock arrives.
sale.priceNote: Prices are today's cash prices; the cashier's invoice is final.
sale.doneBody: Send the customer to the cashier with visit {{visit, bidi}} (file {{fileNo, bidi}}). Dispense once paid.
sale.noAccess: Ask an administrator for walk-in pharmacy sales.

returns.title: Returns
returns.description: Units a patient brings back go on the shelf in the batch they left. Paid units are refunded at the cashier by a credit note.
returns.searchPlaceholder: File number, name, dispense or visit number
returns.emptyHint: Dispenses of the last 30 days show here; search by number or file for older ones.
returns.dialogDescription: {{service}}, batch {{batch, bidi}}. The units go back into this batch and store.
returns.quantityRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to {{max}}
returns.creditNote: Cashier's credit note for these units
returns.paidBody: The return puts the units back on the shelf only. The patient's money is refunded at the cashier with a credit note.
returns.openCashier: Open the visit at the cashier
returns.approverHint: A cashier supervisor or manager confirms the units came back by entering their own username and password.
